## Before you install

**Uninstall the copy you already have.** Releases from here on are signed with a
different key than the ones before them, and Android will not install over a copy
signed with the old one — it stops with `INSTALL_FAILED_UPDATE_INCOMPATIBLE`.
Uninstalling clears the app's own record: where you are in each book, your
bookmarks, and which folder your audiobooks are in. The audiobook files themselves
are not touched, and you can point the app back at the same folder on first launch.

**A widget you have placed will stop working.** The app's internal package names
changed, so a widget placed by an older version no longer finds the code behind it.
Remove it from the home screen and place it again once the new version is installed.
